repo_notes.content: SqlArtisan is a type-safe SQL query builder for C# (.NET 8): you write SQL-like C# and it produces the SQL string plus its bind parameters.

Core principle: 'The SQL you write is the SQL that runs.' SqlArtisan emits SQL faithfully with NO cross-dialect rewriting or translation. Cross-database portability is a deliberate non-goal — never describe SqlArtisan as a portability or abstraction layer over databases.

Supported dialects: MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server (default: PostgreSQL). A construct one dialect lacks is exposed as its own dialect-named API rather than rewritten into another construct.

Mission: a deterministic guard rail for SQL written alongside generative AI, built in four layers — types that make an invalid builder chain fail to compile, a Roslyn analyzer bundled in the SqlArtisan package (docs/analyzer.md lists its rules), exact-SQL unit tests that pin the emitted SQL, and an integration-test matrix run against live database engines.
Opinions live in docs and the analyzer, never in API holes: no legitimate SQL spelling is omitted to steer users.

Four NuGet packages: SqlArtisan (the builder, with the analyzer bundled inside — not shipped separately), SqlArtisan.ArrayBind (Oracle array-bind execution — one round trip per batch, not per row), SqlArtisan.Dapper (sync and async Dapper execution extensions), SqlArtisan.TableClassGen (console tool that generates table classes from a live database).

Terminology: 'table class' (a DbTableBase subclass), never 'table schema class'; 'query builder', not 'SQL builder'. Public factory names mirror SQL tokens with underscores as the only word boundaries (ADD_MONTHS → AddMonths, DATEADD → Dateadd).
Canonical documentation is llms.txt and docs/ in the repository; if this wiki and those files disagree, the repository documentation is authoritative.

Each page's purpose names only its scope: the source folders it covers and the documents to follow. Every fact on a page comes from that code and those documents, and the page links them rather than copying per-dialect support tables, version floors or analyzer rule lists, which change between releases.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What SqlArtisan is, who it is for, and how it compares with other .NET data-access libraries. Documents: README.md, docs/README.md and docs/comparison.md.

pages.title: Design Principles and ADRs
pages.purpose: The architecture decisions that shape the code and what each one rules out. Documents: docs/adr/, starting from docs/adr/README.md, which groups the decisions into clusters to read together.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: The first steps for a new user, with and without an AI coding assistant. Documents: docs/guides/dapper-quickstart.md, docs/guides/ai-assistants.md, llms.txt and the Getting Started section of README.md.

pages.title: Building Statements
pages.purpose: How a statement is assembled, from the public entry point through the builder stages to the built statement. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Sql, src/SqlArtisan/SqlBuilder and src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder. Documents: docs/query-statements.md and docs/cookbook.md.

pages.title: SELECT Queries
pages.purpose: How SELECT statements are built. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/Select, src/SqlArtisan/SqlBuilder and the clause folders under src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Clause and src/SqlArtisan/SqlPart/Clause. Documents: the SELECT Query section of docs/query-statements.md.

pages.title: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE
pages.purpose: How the data-modifying statements are built. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/Insert, src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/Update, src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/Delete and src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/Merge, with the clause folders under src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Clause. Documents: the DELETE, UPDATE, INSERT, RETURNING and OUTPUT sections of docs/query-statements.md.

pages.title: Common Table Expressions
pages.purpose: How WITH clauses are built. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/With, src/SqlArtisan/SqlPart/Clause/With and src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Clause/With. Documents: the WITH section of docs/query-statements.md.

pages.title: Rendering and Bind Parameters
pages.purpose: How a built statement becomes SQL text and bind parameters. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder and src/SqlArtisan/SqlBuilder. Documents: the Bind Parameter Types section of docs/functions.md and the Performance section of README.md.

pages.title: Build-Time Validation
pages.purpose: What building a statement rejects, and when. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder, including src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/Validation. Documents: .claude/rules/guards-and-empty-states.md and the Boundary cluster in docs/adr/README.md.

pages.title: Dialect Layer
pages.purpose: How the target database affects what is built. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlBuilder/DbmsDialect and src/SqlArtisan/SqlBuilder. Documents: .claude/rules/dbms-differences.md and docs/adr/README.md.

pages.title: Expressions and Functions
pages.purpose: How values, conditions, expressions and table references are modeled. Source: src/SqlArtisan/SqlPart and src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart. Documents: docs/expressions.md and docs/functions.md.

pages.title: Operators, Conditions and Subqueries
pages.purpose: Operators, conditions and subqueries. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Expression, src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Condition, src/SqlArtisan/SqlPart/Expression and src/SqlArtisan/SqlPart/Condition. Documents: every section of docs/expressions.md except those the Window Functions and Aggregates page follows.

pages.title: Function Catalog
pages.purpose: The built-in SQL functions and how a new one is added. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Sql, src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Expression/Function and src/SqlArtisan/SqlPart/Expression/Function. Documents: docs/functions.md and .claude/skills/sa-add-sql-function.

pages.title: Window Functions and Aggregates
pages.purpose: Window functions, aggregates and their clauses. Source: src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Clause/Over, src/SqlArtisan/Internal/SqlPart/Clause/WithinGroup, src/SqlArtisan/SqlPart/Clause/Over and the function folders for aggregates and window functions. Documents: the Window Functions, Conditional Aggregation (FILTER) and String Aggregation sections of docs/expressions.md.

pages.title: The Analyzer
pages.purpose: The Roslyn analyzer bundled in the SqlArtisan package: how it is enabled, how its rules are organized and how it reports. Source: src/SqlArtisan.Analyzers. Documents: docs/analyzer.md and the Analyzer cluster in docs/adr/README.md.

pages.title: Dialect Rules
pages.purpose: The analyzer's Dialect category. Source: src/SqlArtisan.Analyzers. Documents: the rules of the Dialect band in docs/analyzer.md (its Bands and categories section gives each band's ID range) and the sections that explain them.

pages.title: Schema-Aware and Validity Rules
pages.purpose: The analyzer's Schema and Validity categories, and the schema metadata on generated table classes that the Schema rules read. Source: src/SqlArtisan.Analyzers and src/SqlArtisan/Metadata. Documents: the rules of the Schema and Validity bands in docs/analyzer.md and the sections that explain them.

pages.title: Analyzer Configuration
pages.purpose: How a project tells the analyzer which dialects and engine versions to check, and the analyzer's compatibility contract. Source: src/SqlArtisan.Analyzers. Documents: docs/analyzer.md and docs/versioning.md.

pages.title: Execution and Tooling
pages.purpose: The packages beside the core builder. Source: src/SqlArtisan.Dapper, src/SqlArtisan.ArrayBind and src/SqlArtisan.TableClassGen.

pages.title: Dapper Integration
pages.purpose: Running built statements through Dapper. Source: src/SqlArtisan.Dapper. Documents: docs/guides/dapper-quickstart.md.

pages.title: Oracle Array Bind
pages.purpose: Running one statement for many rows through Oracle array binding. Source: src/SqlArtisan.ArrayBind. Documents: docs/guides/oracle-array-bind.md.

pages.title: TableClassGen
pages.purpose: Generating table classes from a live database and detecting drift between them and the schema. Source: src/SqlArtisan.TableClassGen and tests/SqlArtisan.TableClassGen.Tests. Documents: src/SqlArtisan.TableClassGen/README.md and docs/versioning.md.

pages.title: Verification and Quality
pages.purpose: How correctness is tested. Source: tests/SqlArtisan.Tests, tests/SqlArtisan.Analyzers.Tests, tests/SqlArtisan.TableClassGen.Tests, tests/SqlArtisan.IntegrationTests and .github/workflows. Documents: the Build & test and CI sections of CLAUDE.md.

pages.title: Performance and Benchmarks
pages.purpose: How build-path performance is measured against other .NET query builders. Source: tests/SqlArtisan.Benchmark. Documents: tests/SqlArtisan.Benchmark/README.md, the Performance section of README.md and docs/comparison.md.

pages.title: Versioning and Releases
pages.purpose: Versioning, compatibility and the release process. Source: Directory.Build.props, src/SqlArtisan.Analyzers/AnalyzerReleases.Shipped.md, src/SqlArtisan.Analyzers/AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md and tools. Documents: docs/versioning.md, CHANGELOG.md and the Release procedure section of CLAUDE.md.
